name: hookline
description: Webhook delivery platform with signing, retries, replay and delivery observability.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hookline/signature && npm run build -w @hookline/api && npm run build -w @hookline/receiver && npm run build -w @hookline/web
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @hookline/signature && npm run build -w @hookline/api && npm run build -w @hookline/receiver
scripts.test:external: npm run build:services && node --test apps/api/dist/test/unit/*.test.js apps/api/dist/test/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:services && node --test apps/api/dist/test/unit/*.test.js packages/signature/dist/test/*.test.js
